About this Event

BIH EVENTS PRESENTS
BOLLYWOOD Takeover
DC's ULTIMATE BOLLYWOOD NIGHTLIFE EXPERIENCE
Get ready for an unforgettable night as Bollywood takes over The Mayflower on November 20 for a massive night of music, energy, and nonstop madness.
Featuring PRABH — the viral hitmaker behind chart-topping tracks like “9:45”, bringing his signature sound and explosive energy to the dancefloor.
Expect a night packed with Bollywood anthems, Punjabi bangers, commercial hits, and high-energy remixes, all under one roof.
